description: Breadcrumb trail (Home > Section > Current page). The alt option renders a compact row of share/social icon links instead.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: breadcrumb navigation trail; alt is a share-links row

contentPattern.structure: the trail items in order: a list of links, one link per row or cell, or one line of links separated by > (the last item may be plain text for the current page). For the alt option, the share links (icons such as :facebook: and :x: inside links)

pagesUsing: all 18 Tourism pages (trail and share row)

reuseGuidance: Use the default for the page trail at the top of content pages; use alt for the small social-share link row. Both were grouped together by the catalog with low confidence; if authors prefer, either can be authored as default content instead.
